evidence_spans: The computed frequency is approximately 5 THz, corresponding to a period of about 200 fs, in agreement with the measured value of 5.1 THz [23].
We apply the extended EOM framework to monolayer MoTe 2.
We therefore focus on the out-of-plane A1g mode, highlighted in Fig. 1(a), consistent with recent coherent-phonon studies of monolayer MoTe2 [20, 23, 24].
The computed frequency is approximately 5 THz, corresponding to a period of about 200 fs, in agreement with the measured value of 5.1 THz [23].
CLM-MAT-0150.statement: The computed frequency of the out-of-plane A1g phonon mode in monolayer MoTe2 is approximately 5 THz.

extra_quotes: First-principles calculations are performed using Quantum ESPRESSO with 12 × 12 × 1 k- and q-point grids [ 39, 40]. To solve the equations of motion, the band energies and electron–phonon matrix elements are interpolated onto a denser 100 × 100 × 1 grid using the Perturbo package [41].
On this dense grid, the time-dependent carrier distribution fnk(t) is obtained by solving the Boltzmann transport equation with electron–phonon scattering using Perturbo.

Carrier-induced and anharmonic frequency renormalization, as well as carrier-dependent phonon dephasing, are not included here; a fully ﬁrst-principles treatment of these eﬀects is beyond the scope of the present work.
Carrier recombination is neglected in our calculations.
